_artifact: OCG chaingraph_export:xbrl — EBA COREP concept-map SCAFFOLD
_status: UNPOPULATED. Maps OCG tool output fields to PUBLIC COREP template/row references. The machine-readable XBRL concepts (eba_met qnames), dimensional members, entry-point schemaRefs, and exact row/col coordinates MUST be populated from the published EBA taxonomy package before this is used to emit a submission. DO NOT FABRICATE eba_met qnames (OCG Standard §13.8 / core project rule). Until eba_qname is populated, exporters/xbrl.mjs returns a 'pending' error for these taxonomies and the ocg-ext profile is used instead.

source_of_truth.note: Download the COREP / Liquidity entry points + the DPM dictionary; bind each eba_qname below to the taxonomy's metric (eba_met:*) and dimensional members. Confirm every template/row reference against the ITS Annexes (templates) and Annex II (instructions).

conventions.entity_identifier_scheme: https://www.gleif.org/ (LEI) — preferred over the tool id used by ocg-ext

conventions.ratios: report as decimals where the taxonomy item is a percentage/decimal; confirm scale per item
conventions.scale_warning: art-07 fields are in billions (suffix _bn) and sim-01 LCR/NSFR are ratios (e.g. 1.45 = 145%). Convert to the taxonomy's expected units/decimals on bind.

_next_steps: 1. Download EBA RF 4.0 COREP-OF and Liquidity entry points + DPM dictionary.
2. For each field with status 'unmapped', set eba_qname to the taxonomy metric qname and add any required dimensional members (eba_dim:*) + their domain members.
4. Confirm every corep_ref against the ITS Annexes; replace '_indicative' with the validated row/col.
5. In exporters/xbrl.mjs, load this map for the eba-corep-* taxonomies and build typed facts with contexts/units/dimensions; remove the 'pending' guard once a taxonomy is fully populated.
6. Validate the emitted instance against the EBA taxonomy with an XBRL processor (e.g. Arelle) before claiming COREP conformance.
